description: A single-masted wooden sailing ship lies at anchor on calm blue water, seen from the end of a wooden pier. The ship is broad and brown with dark planking, a row of pale rail posts along its side, a small grey cabin at the stern and one tall red mast carrying a big triangular grey sail. A thin anchor line runs from the right side into the water. In the foreground a plank pier stretches toward the ship, flanked by two thick red mooring posts joined by sagging grey chains. Above, a bright cyan sky holds a few small white clouds over a deep blue sea. The light is clear and sunny; the mood is a calm harbor before departure. Frame 1: the ship rides level with small ripples around the hull, held long. Frame 2: the ship rises and rocks slightly, the anchor line and ripples shifting. Frame 3: the ship settles back down, held long. Frame 4: the ship rocks the other way, ripples spreading. The loop reads as a slow, gentle rocking on the swell.
title: Sailing ship moored at pier
